ov: فين ماشي يا موشي (بالعربية: إلى أين أنت ذاهب يا موشي) هو فيلم درامي مغربي للمخرج حسن بنجلون وبطولة سيمون الباز وآخرون.
plotEn: Mustapha is the manager of the only bar in the small town of Bejaâd, in Morocco. The Islamic authorities in the town are eager to close it because consumption of alcohol is prohibited to the Muslims, but they cannot do anything since the city remains inhabited by a Jewish community. As long as there are customers who are allowed to consume alcohol, Mustapha is free to go on with his business. But when Moroccan Jews are starting to immigrate to the new state of Israel, and as the town is emptied of its Jewish community, Mustapha is terrified about having to close his business. He will attempt the impossible to keep the only remaining Jew in Boujad, Shlomo Bensoussan—whose wife Freha and daughter Rachel moved to Israel—from leaving the town.
